item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00248","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C25","C04","C13"],"selected_candidate_label":"C25","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C25 plausibly supplied substantial, distinctive drafting machinery for the child. Both restore Hawaiian military-reservation land subject to retained utility easements, authorize relocation at no cost to the United States with Army approval and a replacement map, restrict the restored land to specified National Guard-related uses, and impose reversion to Army control after an unauthorized use continues for sixty days following notice. The close verbal correspondence in these nonroutine conditions is much stronger than the general restoration language shared with other candidates. C04 is the strongest alternative because it concerns the identical Schofield Barracks reservation and supplies closely matching preamble and operative language, while C13 is an earlier Schofield restoration with related land-description conventions, but neither matches the child's conditional machinery as closely as C25.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Territory of Hawaii shall have the right to relocate the said power line at no cost to the United States of America, provided that such relocation shall be acceptable to the Commanding General, United States Army, Pacific, and that the United States of America shall be furnished a map showing the new location of the power line, whereupon the right-of-way shall be deemed to be reestablished at such new location.","parent_excerpt":"The Territory of Hawaii and the City & County of Honolulu, or either of them, shall have the right to relocate the aforesaid cable lines, water lines, sewer lines and facilities at no cost to the United States of America, provided that such relocation shall be acceptable to the Commanding General, United States Army of the Pacific, and that the United States of America shall be furnished a map showing the new location of the lines and facilities, whereupon Easement A, Easement B, Easement C, Easement E, or Easement F, as the case may be, shall be deemed to be reestablished at such new location.","explanation":"This is distinctive, nearly verbatim administrative machinery governing relocation, Army approval, mapping, and automatic reestablishment of a retained easement."},{"child_excerpt":"Until and unless otherwise permitted by the Department of the Army, the parcel of land hereinabove described is to be used for National Guard purposes only, and in the event the said land is used for other purposes, in whole or in part, and such other uses shall continue for a period of sixty days after notice to cease and desist therefrom, then the parcel of land hereinabove described shall revert to the jurisdiction and control of the Department of the Army.","parent_excerpt":"Provided, that until and unless otherwise permitted by the Department of the Army, Parcel 6 shall be used for National Guard, Air National Guard, or civil-defense purposes only. If without such permission Parcel 6 shall be used for other purposes, in whole or in part, and such other use shall continue for a period of sixty days after notice to cease and desist therefrom, then Parcel 6, or the portion thereof in such other use, as the case may be, shall revert to the Jurisdiction and control of the Department of the Army.","explanation":"The child closely reproduces C25's unusually specific use restriction, permission exception, sixty-day cure period after notice, and reversion remedy."},{"child_excerpt":"Subject to the conditions hereinafter stated, the following-described parcel of land comprising part of the Schofield Barracks Military Reservation ... is hereby restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii.","parent_excerpt":"The following-described parcels of land ... comprising portions of Tract No. 1 of Fort Ruger Military Reservation, are hereby restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii ... subject to the limitations hereinafter set forth.","explanation":"The operative restoration framework is parallel and introduces the same type of conditional transfer subsequently implemented through easements and restricted-use/reversion provisions."}]}
